title: Smart Money Buzz Pipeline Input
description: Pulls insider open-market buying (SEC Form 4) for your tickers, counts Reddit and Hacker News chatter for each, scores convergence 0 to 100, and tiers every ticker.

tickers.title: Tickers
tickers.description: Stock tickers to scan, e.g. ["GME", "NVDA", "PLTR"]. The buzz search uses the cashtag form ($TICKER) to keep social matches precise.

companyNames.title: Company names (optional)
companyNames.description: Map of ticker to company name, e.g. {"GME": "GameStop", "SOFI": "SoFi"}. Adds a second social search by name so you also catch posts that never use the cashtag. Optional but improves buzz coverage.

insiderLookbackDays.title: Insider lookback (days)
insiderLookbackDays.description: How far back to pull insider open-market buys and sells from SEC Form 4.

buzzMaxAgeHours.title: Buzz window (hours)
buzzMaxAgeHours.description: Only count Reddit and Hacker News posts newer than this. 168 = 7 days. Social attention is short lived, so keep this tight.

minMentions.title: Minimum mentions for buzz
minMentions.description: A ticker needs at least this many combined Reddit plus Hacker News posts to count as having buzz. Below it, buzz is treated as absent.

includeInsider.title: Include insider buying
includeInsider.description: Pull insider open-market buys and sells. Turn off to score on social buzz alone.

includeBuzz.title: Include social buzz
includeBuzz.description: Pull Reddit and Hacker News chatter. Turn off to score on insider buying alone.

maxPostsPerSource.title: Max posts per social search
maxPostsPerSource.description: Per query cap passed to the Reddit and Hacker News children. Controls cost.

minScore.title: Minimum convergence score
minScore.description: Drop and never charge tickers scoring below this 0 to 100 threshold. 0 keeps every ticker with any signal.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. EDGAR, Reddit RSS, and the HN Algolia API do not need a proxy, so the default is no proxy.
